preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the PocongNFT token to initiate the attack
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens in its balance from fees (at least numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity = 2154 * 10^3 * 10^9)

exploit_hint: The contract has private functions (_takeLiquidity, swapAndLiquify, addLiquidity) that should not be publicly accessible but appear to be callable. First, ensure the contract has accumulated fee tokens. Then call swapAndLiquify() directly to trigger token-to-ETH swap and liquidity addition. This will convert contract tokens to ETH and add liquidity, potentially allowing manipulation of the liquidity pool or extracting value. The attacker may also call _takeLiquidity() to manipulate token balances or addLiquidity() with controlled parameters.
